// Shared preview runs behind an HTTPS tunnel: treat requests as HTTPS and keep visitors out of wp-admin.
$_SERVER['HTTPS'] = 'on';
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( ( is_admin() && ! wp_doing_ajax() ) || 'wp-login.php' === $GLOBALS['pagenow'] ) {
		wp_safe_redirect( home_url( '/' ) );
		exit;
	}
} );
